confirmed.statement: For all five outcomes, AI availability is yes and timing is immediate: the LLM arm had a GPT-3.5-turbo panel beside the idea-submission panel during the task. The comparison arm had Google Search.

confirmed.statement: The rating-method numbers match the source: 300 workers recruited, six ideas per rater, seven-point scales, and 10.6 raters per idea on average. The form already flags the inconsistency among the rating counts.

confirmed.statement: S1-O2 compares idea embeddings with other ideas within the experimental condition and averages divergence per participant. Diversity, embedding_similarity, and participant are supported; this is not a measure confined to one person's ideas.

confirmed.statement: S1-O2 uses one minus average cosine similarity, with higher values indicating more divergence. Footnote 10 names text-embedding-ada-002 and says TF-IDF results are consistent; the form appropriately leaves uncertain comparison-set details unresolved.
